question: Which indigenous Kalvari-class submarine did President Droupadi Murmu undertake a dive and operational sortie aboard, creating history?
solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Vaghsheer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **President Droupadi Murmu created history by undertaking a dive and operational sortie aboard INS Vaghsheer, the sixth and final Kalvari-class submarine of the Indian Navy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **INS Vaghsheer is the sixth and final submarine of the Kalvari-class under Project 75, enhancing India’s underwater combat capabilities.**
 
• **The submarine has been built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited with technology transfer from France.**
 
• **It is named after the sandfish and is equipped with advanced stealth features for operational superiority.**
 
• **Other submarines in the Kalvari-class include Kalvari, Khanderi, Karanj, Vagir, and Vela.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Kalvari-Class Submarines__

 __
 
• These are diesel-electric attack submarines inducted under India’s Project 75 to strengthen underwater defense.
 
• The class is based on the French Scorpene-class design with technology transfer to India.
 
• They incorporate stealth features, modern sensors, and torpedo systems for enhanced combat readiness.
 
 
 
• Project 75__
 __
 
• Indian Navy’s initiative for building six Kalvari-class submarines indigenously in India.
 
• It aims to boost self-reliance in submarine manufacturing and strengthen naval defense capabilities.
 
 
 
• Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited__
 __
 
• One of India’s premier shipyards, responsible for constructing Kalvari-class submarines with transferred French technology.
 
• It plays a key role in India’s indigenous defense manufacturing initiatives.
 
 
 
• INS Vaghsheer’s Operational Significance__
 
 
• Enhances India’s underwater stealth and combat capabilities.
 
• Represents India’s growing expertise in indigenous submarine construction.
 
• Operational sortie by the President underscores national pride and strategic advancement.
